title: Repair 3EN035 Desktop Commander Remote Device startup
description: Replace incorrect plain Desktop Commander MCP startup with Remote Device mode required by ChatGPT Remote MCP. Back up launcher/task, stop only Desktop Commander processes, write stable launcher using npx @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote, update Scheduled Task action, start one instance, and verify process/task state.
backup: $b='C:/3EN-Agent/backups/rdc-remote-repair-'+(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss);New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $b -Force|Out-Null;if(Test-Path 'C:/3EN-Agent/start-remote-desktop-commander.cmd'){Copy-Item 'C:/3EN-Agent/start-remote-desktop-commander.cmd' $b -Force};$t=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($t){Export-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander'|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $b '3EN-Remote-Desktop-Commander.xml') -Encoding UTF8};Write-Host ('RDC_BACKUP='+$b)
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$log=Join-Path $root 'rdc-startup.log';$launcher=Join-Path $root 'start-remote-desktop-commander.cmd';Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er'}|ForEach-Object {Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$npx=(Get-Command npx.cmd -ErrorAction Stop).Source;$lines=@('@echo off','echo [%date% %time%] RDC REMOTE START >> "'+$log+'"','"'+$npx+'" -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote >> "'+$log+'" 2>&1','echo [%date% %time%] RDC REMOTE EXIT ERRORLEVEL=%ERRORLEVEL% >> "'+$log+'"');Set-Content -LiteralPath $launcher -Value $lines -Encoding ASCII;$action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'cmd.exe' -Argument ('/d /c "'+$launcher+'"');$settings=New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew -ExecutionTimeLimit ([TimeSpan]::Zero);Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander' -Action $action -Settings $settings|Out-Null;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander';Start-Sleep -Seconds 12;Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er'}|Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine|Format-List;Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander'|Select-Object TaskName,State|Format-Table -AutoSize;if(Test-Path $log){Get-Content $log -Tail 100};Write-Host 'RDC_REMOTE_REPAIR_EXECUTED=PASS'
test: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'desktop-commander' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'remote'};if(-not $p){throw 'No Desktop Commander remote process found'};$i=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName '3EN Remote Desktop Commander';Write-Host ('RDC_REMOTE_PROCESS_COUNT='+@($p).Count);Write-Host ('RDC_TASK_LAST_RESULT='+$i.LastTaskResult);Write-Host 'RDC_REMOTE_RUNTIME=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'RDC rollback available from newest C:/3EN-Agent/backups/rdc-remote-repair-* backup'
